Chatbot (Retrieval Augmentation Generation) GenAI: - Working in utilizing GenAI for Retrieval Augmentation Generation (RAG) within the Semiconductor sector, I led the successful execution of end-to-end RAG architecture to overcome specific business challenges. Knowledge Search (Question & Answer) GenAI: - Implemented a knowledge search(Q&A) system for client by leveraging GPT3, GPT3.5, and GPT4 models. Integrated a structured data pipeline to fetch details from snowflake database by generating snowflake query with the help of prompts. Implemented article and summary generation, showcase business Insights by using research and news documents. Limit the model to provide any sensitive information or personal information and connected the user interface with a Rest API for seamless data exchange.
Locomotive Part Failure Prediction: -
The objective of this project is to predict the is failure of Locomotive parts based on different machine components. Locomotive failure prediction using different Time series Algorithms.
Identified last transactions happened for all locomotive parts for maintenance from raw data and we predicted maintenance cost for next coming years.
